# monotaur_alarm_note (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur alarm note (an entry of an alarm's incident timeline) by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_alarm_note" "update" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the note to look up.

### Read-Only

- `alarm_id` (String) The ID of the alarm the note belongs to.
- `author` (String) Who wrote the note, e.g. `service-account:12`.
- `body` (String) The note text, in markdown.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the note was created (its time on the timeline).
- `kind` (String) The stage of incident response the note reports: `Investigating`, `Mitigating` or `Resolved`.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the public status page may show the note.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the note was last updated.
